title: Settings
overview: This guide covers settings workflows for Practice Caregiver.

subtasks.title: Account Setting (profile, session, cache, 2FA)
subtasks.purpose: View caregiver profile, control session timeout, refresh the cache, and check Two-Way Authentication state.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Open Settings — the Account Setting tab is active by default (Follow Up Setting is the second tab).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Review read-only profile fields: Full Name, Username, Email, Phone, Fax, and Current Session Time.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Check Two Way Authentication — the badge shows Enabled or Disabled; contact the practice admin to change this state.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To extend or shorten sessions, type a new value into Session Time (minutes) and click Update — the Current Session Time reflects the new value on the next login.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Click Refresh next to Clear Cache to force the workspace to re-fetch reference data (patients, providers, dropdowns) when values look stale.

subtasks.title: Follow Up Setting (thresholds & escalation cadence)
subtasks.purpose: Configure the follow-up rules that populate the Care Mgmt → Follow Up Query results.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Open Settings → Follow Up Setting (second tab beside Account Setting).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Adjust the cadence / threshold fields exposed on the tab (e.g. days since last reading, missed-reading count) and save the changes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Return to Care Mgmt → Follow Up Query and re-run the query to confirm the new rules populate the expected patients.
